title: config/toolchain.json
description: The toolchains that no other file of the checkout declares. npm is declared in devEngines.packageManager of package.json, Rust in rust-toolchain.toml, and the tools that mise installs (Node.js, Go, Python, uv, ruff, alint, golangci-lint, deadcode, govulncheck, cargo-audit, cargo-nextest, cargo-deny, Composer, vulture) in mise.toml with their digests in mise.lock; php may also be declared in .php-version.

php.description: The PHP minor releases that the checks run on; a patch release of a listed minor passes.

phpunit.description: The PHPUnit release of the PHP tests of kit: install-tools installs the Composer project of config/phpunit (composer.json and composer.lock) into var/tools/phpunit with the Composer of mise.toml.

mise.description: The mise release that the bootstrap installs first, into var/tools/mise-release, then with it the node and npm of mise.toml: the exact version, and the sha256 of the archive mise-v<version>-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz of the GitHub release of each platform key (process.platform-process.arch), the digest read as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. mise installs the tools of mise.toml into var/tools/mise at the digests of mise.lock.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the mise archive of each platform key; the bootstrap refuses an archive of another digest.

symbolExtractors.description: The symbol extractors of config/parity.json that make kit-install-symbols builds into var/tools/symbols-<extractor> (K861) (scripts/kit/install-symbols.mts): go, the program of scripts/kit/symbols/go on golang.org/x/tools/go/packages; php, the Composer project of scripts/kit/symbols/php with nikic/php-parser, installed with the Composer of mise.toml.

exceptions.description: The declared exceptions to the pins of kit (S4): each names the pinned tool, the channel that its scope uses instead of the pin, the scope ("." or a directory of the checkout), the reason and the condition under which the pin is tried again.
